children: Valuno Group AB (publ) announces the commercial launch of Vestri, the Group’s technology platform for embedded financial services. Vestri is designed to enable businesses and financial-service providers to launch and operate banking, payment and card products through one integrated platform. The new Vestri website is now live at
and the platform is being introduced to customers and partners.

Vestri brings together the core technology required across the financial lifecycle – from onboarding and compliance to accounts and wallets, payments, foreign exchange, card issuing and acquiring, reconciliation and settlement. The platform is built around an API-led core and can be integrated directly into customers’ existing products and infrastructure.

A central feature of Vestri is its provider-flexible architecture. Banking, FX, verification and card-processing providers can be connected through defined integration boundaries, reducing dependency on individual external providers and allowing the underlying infrastructure to evolve as customer requirements change.

Vestri complements Valuno’s existing stablecoin-focused Atlas platform and broadens the Group’s technology offering across financial infrastructure and digital assets. The two platforms address different parts of the market while creating opportunities for integration between traditional payment infrastructure and stablecoin and blockchain-based settlement.

“With Vestri, we are taking a modernised, established technology platform into its next commercial phase and creating a second business line alongside Atlas. Our ambition is to make it considerably easier for companies to launch and operate modern financial products without having to build and integrate the entire infrastructure themselves. Vestri and Atlas address different parts of the financial infrastructure market, but together they significantly broaden Valuno’s commercial offering”, says Peter Liljeroos, CEO of Valuno Group AB.
Peter Liljeroos, CEO, Valuno Group AB (publ)

Valuno Group AB (publ) is a Stockholm-based company listed on NGM Nordic SME, developing infrastructure for modern cross-border payments. Its Atlas platform connects bank money, stablecoins and blockchain settlement through an intelligent orchestration layer – enabling businesses to move money across borders faster, more transparently and cost-effectively. Valuno was founded in 2016 and has been listed since 2019. For more information, visit www.investor.valuno.com.
